newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent firmer Monday, based on market orders at 1019 EDT, traders said.
Technically, the market remains poised to climb higher. Spot May ended over resistance on Friday, settling at 73.00 cents a lb. The deferred months closed 0.65 to 0.05 higher.
Drier weather in the Delta will be favorable for early planting while rainfall in Texas is expected to delay planting this week, Weather Services Corp said.
